INSERT INTO video_analysis (
  analysis_id,
  video_url,
  video_duration,
  transcription_text,
  word_count,
  scene_labels_count,
  tracked_objects_count,
  detected_text,
  combined_safety_score,
  content_rating,
  brand_safe,
  violations,
  explicit_frames_detected,
  recommendation,
  full_analysis_data,
  processing_time_ms
) VALUES (
  '{{ $json.analysis_id }}',
  '{{ $json.video_info.url }}',
  {{ $json.video_info.duration }},
  '{{ $json.transcription.text }}',
  {{ $json.transcription.word_count }},
  {{ $json.visual_analysis.scene_labels.length }},
  {{ $json.visual_analysis.tracked_objects.length }},
  '{{ $json.visual_analysis.detected_text }}',
  {{ $json.content_moderation.combined_safety_score }},
  '{{ $json.content_moderation.content_rating }}',
  {{ $json.content_moderation.brand_safe }},
  '{{ JSON.stringify($json.content_moderation.violations) }}',
  {{ $json.content_moderation.explicit_frames_detected }},
  '{{ $json.content_moderation.recommendation }}',
  '{{ JSON.stringify($json) }}',
  {{ $json.metadata.processing_time_ms }}
) RETURNING *;
